title: Fluorescence Measurement Protocol
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8f9htr6
materials: Inoculate one colony in the prepared LB medium

steps.title: Prepare LB medium
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 ml of LB medium containing the appropriate antibiotic resistance and add 0.5 % ml Tergitol.

steps.title: Add fatty acid
steps.instruction: Add the desired fatty acid to the culture medium to a final concentration between 0.01 mM and 1 mM.

steps.title: Inoculate culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate the culture and incubate for at least 16 hours at 37 °C.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the culture at 600 nm using a photometer.

steps.title: Dilute to OD600 0.05
steps.instruction: Dilute the culture with fresh LB medium to reach an optical density at 600 nm (OD600) of 0.05.

steps.title: Fill 24‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 800 µl of the diluted culture into each well of a 24‑well plate, arranging three biological replicates each with three technical replicates as indicated in the experimental layout.

steps.title: Incubate 24‑well plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the 24‑well plate at 37 °C for at least 16 hours.

steps.title: Transfer to 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the cultured samples from the 24‑well plate to a 96‑well plate according to the specified layout (including blanks).

steps.title: Measure fluorescence and OD
steps.instruction: Using a plate reader, measure the fluorescence at the appropriate excitation/emission wavelengths and record the OD600 for each well.
